_meta.description: Provenance registry for sense-assignment runs. Each prompt_id names a specific prompt-contract/model combination. Named acceptance policies, not numeric tiers, decide which model claims may enter a live deck. Historical capability_tier fields remain descriptive migration metadata only.

sd-cop-v1.notes: Menu-pick only — Gemini picks a sense from the SpanishDict menu; no off-menu proposal path.

sd-cop-v2.notes: Classify-or-propose — Gemini may return sense=null and propose an off-menu meaning (pos/type/construction). The gap-fill / off-menu signature in the data.

sd-cop-v3.notes: Same classify-or-propose prompt as sd-cop-v2 on the newer gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Higher tier: supersedes sd-cop-v2 answers once the tier-based resolver is wired. Current default (SD_DEFAULT_MODEL); step_6c stamps new runs with this id.

sd-lexical-v1-g31.notes: Lexical WSD only. Picks a stable menu sense or proposes a short missing lexical gloss, including genuine slang. Proper-noun, usage-tag, construction and POS decisions are owned by separate upstream evidence layers; construction-only and excluded material must abstain.

sd-lexical-v2-g35.notes: Gemini 3.5 successor to sd-lexical-v1-g31. Preserves the menu-first lexical-only contract and adds exact one-call-per-example, verbatim menu-id, and non-empty null-answer requirements after 74 invalid outputs were observed in the completed 3.1 reports.

sd-lexical-v2-g31.notes: Revised lexical-only prompt on the validated Gemini 3.1 baseline. Same semantic contract as v1 plus exact output-completeness requirements. Evaluation candidate until explicitly accepted.

sd-lexical-v2-g25.notes: Cost-control evaluation candidate using the exact revised lexical-only prompt. Never accepted merely because it is cheaper.

legacy-unknown.notes: Pre-provenance assignment. Exact model/prompt is not recoverable from the stored format (bare menu-picks look identical across 2.5 and 3.1). Any stamped run supersedes this tier.

embed-gloss-classgap-hub-v1.notes: Not a generative prompt. Sense vector from the English gloss '"word" (POS): translation — context'; sentence embedded once; nearest sense by cosine after subtracting a per-sense hubness offset measured offline against a fixed background sample; confidence is the gap between the top two MEANINGS, not leaves. Precision measured on a hand-labelled panel at Data/Spanish/Intermediates/wsd_sense_harness: 100% acceptable at gap>=0.035, 91.9% at gap>=0.021, 84.5% overall.

embed-gloss-tuplegap-hub-v1.notes: Same picks as embed-gloss-classgap-hub-v1; confidence regrouped from (POS, translation) classes to (headword, POS) TUPLES. Yield at 99% lemma+POS goes 6 items -> 13,224 of 84,174. Band cuts re-derived to 0.043/0.020 on 16,016 target-present gold sentences.

sd-beto-cal-v1.notes: Gloss embeddings + BETO token-prototype scoring + se-only clitic gate, ranked by a learned calibrator. Held-out yield at 99% lemma+POS 43.7% on the full population (22.9% for the tuple gap alone); 53.7% on the 64% with prototype coverage.

artist-lexical-wsd-current.description: Model-authored lexical WSD claims allowed into active Artist decks and inspectors.

rejected_prompt_ids.sd-cop-v2: old mixed-task prompt with known over-translation failures
rejected_prompt_ids.legacy-unknown: prompt and model cannot be established

speech-embed-wsd-current.description: Speech/normal mode: only embedding-WSD runs may author sense claims. Every historical Gemini pass is rejected -- they carry legacy-unknown provenance. preference_order is NAMED, not numeric: earlier ids win ties.

rejected_prompt_ids.legacy-unknown: prompt and model cannot be established; all 46,985 historical normal-mode claims carry this
rejected_prompt_ids.sd-cop-v2: old mixed-task prompt with known over-translation failures

testplaylist-beto-cal-pinned.description: Deliberately PINNED to one run so a deck can be evaluated in isolation. Unlike the *-current policies, which admit several generators and let preference_order pick the best evidence per example, this admits exactly one -- so every card is attributable to sd-beto-cal-v1 and nothing else. Intended for Artists/spanish/SpanishTestPlaylist.
